Production AI apps need visibility into cost, latency, safety checks and quality regressions. PraisonAIUI includes six modular observability and safety plugins you can enable individually or all at once.

Plugin Page ID What it tracks Key endpoints Usage (builtin.usage) usage Token counts, model breakdown, session/agent totals and estimated costs GET /api/usage/summary, /models, /sessions, /agents, /timeseries, /costs, POST /api/usage/track Traces (builtin.traces) traces End-to-end execution traces and nested tool/LLM spans GET /api/traces, GET /api/traces/spans, GET /api/traces/{trace_id}, POST /api/traces/record Telemetry (builtin.telemetry) telemetry Runtime latency metrics, performance snapshots and profiling GET /api/telemetry, /metrics, /performance, /profiling, POST /api/telemetry/record Logs (builtin.logs) logs Live searchable server and agent log stream GET /api/logs, GET /api/logs/stream Guardrails (builtin.guardrails) guardrails Active safety rules and recorded policy violations GET /api/guardrails, /violations, POST /api/guardrails/register, DELETE /api/guardrails/{id} Evals (builtin.eval) eval Automated judges, evaluation runs and quality scores GET /api/eval, /judges, /scores, POST /api/eval/run
To disable any non-required plugin and skip importing its backend module (R2/R4), list it under extensions.disabled: in aiui.yaml (e.g. builtin.eval, builtin.telemetry).
